top_choice_rationale: P004 (Corma, Davis, Zones) recognises the most mature and structurally best-evidenced case of architecture determining function: pore topology and site placement in zeolite and molecular-sieve catalysts are controlled by structure-directing agents and template chemistry, verified by diffraction for decades, with very large industrial impact. The citation is scoped to rational design, not the older foundational work of Barrer, Milton and Breck. I accept that the three-name limit leaves out Yu and Tsapatsis and that I am its only supporter. Below it I rank P002 (mature, mechanistically explained ligand-design chemistry with broad community use), then P001 (real science but PROTAC and cereblon strands joined in one citation, with Ciulli unrecognised and no approved degrader), then P003 (attribution to one laboratory ignores independent Target-AID work and sits close to the 2020 prize), then P005 (physiological relevance not settled), and no award last.
recusal_note: P004 lies in my own research field (zeolites and porous framework materials) and I know the community, including Jihong Yu, professionally; my profile records no collaboration, mentorship or institutional tie to Corma, Davis, Zones, Yu or Tsapatsis. Procedural note: Stockholm University colleague of Secretary Brzezinski.
